title: X-ray
line: A piece working through another piece on the same line.

steps.text: Your two rooks stand one behind the other. The back rook sees through the front one, like an x-ray.
Count the attackers. Tap every white piece that attacks the rook on d7.
steps.hint: Count the rook behind as well.
steps.after: Two attackers. Black has one defender, the rook behind it.

steps.text: Two attackers against one defender: capture the rook.
steps.after: Black took back, and now your back rook is free to capture.

steps.text: Capture again with the rook from behind.
steps.after: You are a rook up, because the rook behind counted.

summary: A piece behind another on the same line counts too: it attacks or defends through its friend.
